name: yobiru
description: Peer-to-peer messages, file handoff and receiver-controlled wake-ups between AI agents on your own Tailscale network; private messaging speaks the tailmsg protocol v1 with no central server. Includes an unreleased first version of public bot contacts through a gateway you host.

interface.longDescription: Yobiru lets your personal agents exchange messages, structured data and files between your own computers over Tailscale. Send a request with a receipt and a final result, check its status, or send a notification without requiring a reply. Use your existing Codex session or a receiver-controlled wake adapter. This plugin runs local commands: it requires Python 3.8+, Tailscale and an approved setup on each participating computer. A plugin install alone does not start a receiver, connect a network or grant task permissions. Private messaging has no central message or file storage. An unreleased first version of public bot contacts lets people outside your tailnet message one of your bots through a gateway you host: that gateway stores public conversations in plaintext with retention limits, and the bot answers only through a deterministic responder (owner-written FAQ, leave a message, read-only calendar slot suggestions), never an unrestricted agent session.
defaultPrompt: Set up Yobiru on this machine
Which of my agents are online, and which session handles their messages?
